parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-05 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1320.7 | 0.60 | 0.60
2 | 719.2 | 0.46 | 1.06
3 | 872.7 | 0.61 | 1.67
4 | 340.7 | 0.38 | 2.05
5 | 4088.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-05
Curve type: HKH
Aquifer depth: 1.67 m – 2.05 m
Recommendation: The low-resistivity zone (Layer 4, 340.7 ohm-m) sandwiched between resistive layers indicates a thin, shallow saturated zone; drill with care through this narrow interval and install screen/casing across 1.67–2.05 m. Given the limited thickness, expect a low-yield well and consider this zone suitable only for hand-pump or small-scale domestic supply rather than high-capacity abstraction.
